title: כרטיס לפני שיחה + המשך טיפול אחרי אין מענה
verdict: STAGING PASS — live E2E of the new flow, not the previous cleanup report

rootCause.cardBeforeCall: handleWorkFromList claimed the next assigned lead and immediately called beginCall. The 4th button started the conversation before the employee saw the card.
rootCause.noAnswerLost: Reporting «לא ענה» did not create or keep a Follow-up unless the agent also checked «נדרשת המשכיות». The lead stayed claimed, so the numbered queue skipped to the next lead and #1 disappeared from continued treatment.

whatWasFixed: עבודה מרשימת לידים claims lead #N, fills the card, shows tele-lead-preview, and does not start the call.
While a lead is previewed, the 4th button is hidden so the agent cannot skip to the next number.
התחל שיחה is the only action that starts the claimed lead (existing timer / beginCall).
«לא ענה» / לנסות שוב / לחזור אליו auto-creates or keeps Follow-up as המשך טיפול on the same lead number.
Re-entry from המשך טיפול opens the same card first; it does not auto-start.
A later attempt writes a new call row on the same company/lead number and keeps history.
Only a final/disqualify result (לא מעוניין / לא רלוונטי / מספר שגוי) or a booked outcome closes continued treatment.
keptExistingMechanisms: Follow-up tables and MyFollowUps board (retitled המשך טיפול)
רמזור, 🟣, Timeline, reports, Import/Export, assignment, manual lead

proofFlow: Lead #1 מערכות אשד — card before call (tele-lead-preview, no סיום שיחה)
Click התחל שיחה — call started on ליד #1
Report לא ענה — toast נשמר בהמשך טיפול; open Follow-up המשך טיפול — אין מענה
Re-enter same lead from המשך טיפול — card again, call not auto-started
Second attempt — same ליד #1, history kept (qa-continue-e2e no-answer 1)
Final לא מעוניין — Follow-up status=done; lead left continued treatment

regression.button1StartCall: PASS — tele-start-call present before, during preview, and on mobile
regression.button2WorkMission: PASS — התחל משימת עבודה remained on agent home
regression.button4WorkFromList: PASS — present when idle; hidden only while a lead card is previewed
regression.claimLock: PASS — still claimNextAssignedLead / claimAssignedLead; no rewrite
regression.followUp: PASS — existing Follow-up rows used for המשך טיפול
regression.trafficLight: PASS — yellow mapping for לא ענה unchanged
regression.timeline: PASS — התחל המשך טיפול opens card, does not auto-start
